Cue 1.1 · .tinypeep
made with love by Gabriel Benzoni
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gabrielbenzoni
GitHub: https://github.com/tinypeep

Cue is free of charge. Its own code is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
The full terms are available in this reader's Cue · GPLv3 document.

PLAYBACK ENGINE
libmpv with FFmpeg, libplacebo, libass, HarfBuzz, FriBidi, FreeType, dav1d,
zlib, Shaderc, glslang, SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Headers, SPIRV-Cross,
Vulkan-Headers (headers), and FastFloat. The combined engine distribution uses
LGPL-3.0-or-later; individual components retain their licenses and notices.
Select a document in the reader for its full text.

FONTS AND ASSETS
Cue Omni, Cue Clean (Inter), and Cue Readable (Atkinson Hyperlegible) use
SIL Open Font License 1.1. License texts and attribution are included.
Custom project assets follow GPL; see Copyright and license scope.

SOURCE CODE
https://github.com/tinypeep/cue/releases/tag/v1.1
- Source code (zip): application source generated by GitHub for the release.
- Cue-1.1-Engine-Source.zip: sources, notices, and build recipes for the
  16 components corresponding to the included playback DLL.
The source-code button opens the sources folder with this address.

Preserve the complete program folder when redistributing. The DLL remains
replaceable with modified versions compatible with the libmpv API.
